messages:
anya: quick check-in on the compact picker + SLO presets in the latest mock. dropped Figma: https://figma.com/file/compact123

jess: saw it. biggest friction is scanning a flat list on wide orgs. propose a tiny 'Frequent' strip above the list with 4 buttons (usage + pinned). reduces jumps.

mike: backend can return a preferredPools field. small change, low risk. will add event names: ui.pool.freq.select

omar: accessibility: those 4 buttons must have clear labels (e.g., aria-label="Recommended: low-latency pool"). 44px target min, visible focus.

lee: copy on the burst toggle feels terse. folks keep asking if burst means extra billing. new label idea: "Burst capacity (time-limited)" + inline help icon linking to pricing.

khalid: agree. also ensure help link is keyboard-focusable and announced by SRs. don't hide it behind hover.

jess: for compact mode the label truncates badly. use "Burst (time-limited)" in the UI and the full sentence in the help panel.

nora: SLO slider: can we move away from technical units? use presets: "Economy, Balanced, Low-latency (SLO)". show a one-line explanator under selection: "Lower latency uses more baseline capacity."

mike: implementation: we can map presets to capacity targets server-side. need to confirm we only send preset id not raw numbers.

anya: keyboard and SR flow: slider must expose stepper fallback. Arrow keys change preset incrementally, Enter confirms. When changed, announce via aria-live: "Latency target: Balanced. Cost: Medium."

omar: aria-live should be polite and under 60 chars. also, for the selected pool add a hidden SR hint: "Selected pool: general-purpose, SLO: medium latency".

lee: min/max labeling: replace shorthand with full labels: "Min active GPUs" / "Max active GPUs". ensure the labels use <label> or aria-labelledby.

khalid: voiceover case: if user requests Min that's higher than poolMax, we should clamp and announce: "Requested min 8 clamped to pool max 4." Keep it short.

jess: UI behavior: when hovering a pool in the list show a right-side mini-card with 3 facts: SLO tier, typical throughput, cost bucket (Low/Med/High). no %s.

mike: cost buckets only, agreed. also client should cache pool caps for ~120s to avoid extra calls (some caps live in another service).

nora: color/contrast: current SLO pill uses light blue text on pale bg, fails AA. switch to token pair bg-strong / text-on-strong or outline at 4.5:1. I'll add token suggestions.

omar: tooltips must have keyboard equivalents. use aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip element and ensure it appears on focus as well as hover.

anya: tiny copy tweak: change the preset 'Best-effort' to 'Economy' — customers understood that more.

jess: agree. also add microcopy under quick picks: "Most used by your org" to explain why they appear.

lee: QA & rollout: add tests for keyboard-only selection, SR walkthrough, clamp messaging, and compact truncation.

khalid: i'll draft the SR test scripts. include the exact aria-live strings.

mike: will confirm API fields and preferredPools return by EOD.

anya: next steps: jess to update frames with quick strip + badge contrast + burst microcopy. omar and khalid to review a11y tokens. mike to confirm API. nora to upload token notes. i'll prep release blurb and canary flags.

jess: on it 64c will post frames tomorrow morning.

anya: thanks team :thumbsup:
